en: Ooh, you made us look silly! I'm putting you in our PokéNav so we can win it back.
Register Kira and Dan in the PokéNav's Match Call?
Dan, did you hear? We've got a rival now!
Hmph! We'll just have to find you again ourselves.
Only one Pokémon? We battle two at a time, you know. Come back with a partner for it!
